title: Wound & Bandage TV Anime Reveals Main Cast, January 9 Debut in Teaser Video
content:
The official website for television anime of Umihoshi Nanai 's Wound & Bandage ( Kizuguchi to Hōtai ) manga revealed a teaser promotional video on Friday. The website also revealed the anime's main cast and January 9 debut.

The anime stars Hisako Kanemoto as Riyo Washizu, and Chikahiro Kobayashi as Gō Kiritani.

Miyuki Ishida ( I.Cinnamoroll , director, One Punch Man season 2 and 3 episode director) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Susumu Yamakawa ( The Way of the Househusband three seasons, Murai in Love ) is writing the scripts, and Natsuki Ōyama ( Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive? ) is designing the characters.

The romantic comedy centers on Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the leader of the yakuza organization that occupies the Kanto region of Japan. Gō Kiritani, a young subordinate in the organization, becomes Riyo's caretaker. He expects her to be just a docile child, but he soon learns that Riyo has a certain fetish — she loves seeing strong people when they are weak.

The manga debuted on Kodansha 's Comic Days app in August 2024. Kodansha shipped the fifth volume on July 16.
author: ANN

title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Friday two more cast members for Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot . Both characters will appear in the show's 15th episode on October 18.

Hirofumi Nojima as Umezō, an inhabitant of the magical country Felix Star.

Shōgo Yano as Tachibana, an actor playing the headmaster's son in the drama Lilly and Rin are shooting.

The anime's first part premiered on April 5 on the Tokyo MX channel, and also runs on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X . The anime is running for two cours , with a break in between. The anime's second part debuted on October 4.

The anime is available on streaming services such as Ani-One and Bahamut in Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; Anime Generation and Man-ga (television broadcast) in Italy; Anime Box in Spain; and on various services in Taiwan. Tubi also streams the anime in the United States and Canada.

Bandai Namco Filmworks ' YouTube channel started streaming the anime's first two episodes on April 18, which has subtitles in 16 languages including English. The episodes are available in North America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and in parts of Europe, Africa, and Asia. Bandai Namco Filmworks has continued streaming the anime's episodes, with the 13th episode posted on October 10, and now has subtitles in 26 languages. As of writing, the anime's full episodes are not available in Southeast Asia.

Previously announced new cast members for the second part include Miyari Nemoto as Asahi Araki, Yusuke Shirai as Mucchi, and Yūko Natsuyoshi as Shiromofu.

K-pop girl group ILLIT performs the new opening theme song "Swingin' Magic." The idol unit Lulutto Lilly, which consists of the anime's main characters Lilly Konpeto (voiced by May Tachibana ) and Lulu Mashū (voiced by Nao Ojika ) perform the new ending theme song "Dream a la Mode."

Shintarō Dōge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director, Pet episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Pierrot , and is credited for the original character designs. Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Namiko Tori ( Pokémon: Paldean Winds sub-character designer), Hirono Nishiki ( My Dress-Up Darling episode key animator), and Asami Sodeyama ( Witchy Precure! -MIRAI DAYS- ) are designing the characters.

The anime's story centers on sisters Fū and Rui, who used to be close, but have been a bit distant from each other recently. One day, Fū encounters a mysterious spaceship and gains magical powers. At that same time, Rui also gains magical powers, and both transform into the adults they dream to be. The sisters' powers come with two conditions: their magic powers can only be used in one year, and no one must know about it. Unaware of each other's secrets, Fū and Rui become active as idols.

title: 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Reveals Main Cast, Teaser Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nanai Umihoshi 's Kizuguchi to Houtai ( Wound and Bandage ) manga revealed the main cast, a theme visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere on January 9, 2027 at 11:00 p.m. on AT-X, followed by ABC TV and TV Asahi on the ANiMAZiNG programming block.

Voice actors Hisako Kanemoto ( Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun ) and Chikahiro Kobayashi ( Beastars ) are starring as Riyo Washizu and Gou Kiritani, respectively.

Miyuki Ishida ( Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!) assistant director) is helming the anime at J.C.Staff , with Susumu Yamakawa ( Gokushufudou series composition) penning the script. Natsuki Ooyama ( 2.5-jigen no Ririsa animation director) is designing the characters.

Umihoshi originally began the romantic comedy manga as a one-shot in Getsumaga Kichi magazine in February 2024. The manga began serializing in Comic Days magazine the following August. Kodansha published the fifth volume on July 16.

Teaser PV (Love ver.)

title: Magical DoReMi, Star Detective Precure! Anime Get Crossover Episode on October 25
content:
The official website for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise , revealed on Friday that the anime will have a crossover episode with the Ojamajo Doremi ( Magical DoReMi ) anime with its 39th episode on October 25. The site unveiled a collaboration visual, as well as character visuals for the Star Detectives in Ojamajo Doremi -themed witch apprentice costumes.

The story of Star Detective Precure! is set in 1999, the year of the original Ojamajo Doremi anime's premiere. The crossover episode will be a Halloween-themed episode that has the Star Detectives donning the witch apprentice costumes.

The first Ojamajo Doremi anime series originally premiered in Japan in 1999, and 4Kids began broadcasting a heavily edited version of the series in the United States in 2005 under the title Magical DoReMi . Looking for Magical DoReMi ( Majo Minarai o Sagashite ), the anime film commemorating the 20th anniversary of Ojamajo Doremi , opened in 2020 after a delay. It won the Best Animation Film award at the 75th Mainichi Film Awards in 2021.

Star Detective Precure! debuted on February 1 on ABC TV, TV Asahi , and their affiliate channels at 8:30 a.m. JST. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in North America, Central America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and CIS.

The anime centers on Anna Akechi, a second year middle school student who lives in Makoto Mirai Town. She travels back in time from 2027 to 1999 when her "companion fairy" named Pochitan appears on her birthday. In 1999 Makoto Mirai Town, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, another second year middle school student who dreams of becoming a great detective. The two girls witness the troubles caused by the Phantom Thieves who steal people's precious belongings, and they transform into great Precure detectives and use their deductive reasoning skills to protect the people's smiles.

title: Singer Kenshi Yonezu Goes on World Tour in Early 2027
content:
Sony Music announced on Thursday that singer-songwriter Kenshi Yonezu will go on a concert world tour in early 2027. The tour is titled " KENSHI YONEZU 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR / GHOST."

The dates and venues of the tour include:

• January 14, 16, 17: Inspire Arena, Seoul, South Korea

• January 29: Singapore Indoor Stadium, Singapore

• February 4: Oakland Arena, Oakland, CA, USA

• February 6: Kia Forum, Los Angeles, CA, USA

• February 9: Palacio de los Deportes, Mexico City, Mexico

• February 12: Prudential Center, Newark, NJ, USA

• February 14: Scotiabank Arena, Toronto, Canada

• February 24: The O2 Arena, London, UK

• February 26: Accor Arena, Paris, France

• February 28: Ziggo Dome, Amsterdam, Netherlands

Yonezu began his career as Vocaloid composer Hachi in 2009, and also illustrated the music videos for his songs. He released two albums as Hachi, before his third album diorama in 2012, where he sang using his real voice and credited himself under his real name Kenshi Yonezu . Yonezu has performed theme songs for multiple anime and games, including Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli 's The Boy and the Heron , My Hero Academia , Chainsaw Man , Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc , Fireworks, Should We See it from the Side or the Bottom? , Children of the Sea , March comes in like a lion , Final Fantasy XVI , the live-action 5 Centimeters per Second film, the live-action Shin Ultraman film, and the live-action Look Back film (where he is credited as "Shark Kick Guitar").
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Streams Dub for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will begin streaming an English dub for the third anime season based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series on Friday. The dub cast includes:

• Emi Lo as Maomao

• Kaiji Tang as Jinshi

• Jad Saxton as White Lady

• Suzie Yeung as Shisui

• Anne Yatco as Kyou-u

• Nazeeh Tarsha as Guard

• Wendy Powell as Madam

• Oscar Seung as Ukyou

• Seth Fuentes as Lihaku

• Eli Farmer as Onsou

• Monica Rial as Narrator

• Rebecca Danae as Meimei

• Caleb Yen as Lahan

• Alex Mai as Emperor

• Ricco Fajardo as Lakan

• Reshel Mae as Lishu

• Charles Nguyen as Rikuson

• Seth Magill as Uryuu

• Phil Parsons as Gyokuen

• Adrian Godinez as Mr. Owner

• Tom Aglio as Niban

• Monica Rial as Ah-Duo

• Alex Hom as Gaoshun

• Ed Escamilla as Basen

• Monica Flatley as Joka

• Kit Lozano as Kanan

• Additional Voices by Paxton Lee, Nasim Benelkour, Mauricio Ortiz-Segura, Brandon Acosta, Daniela Valkova, Elizabeth Hohman

The staff members for the dub include:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Susie Nixon

• Adaptation Supervisor: Macy Anne Johnson

• Adaptation: Clayton Browning

• Adaptation Prep: Benjamin Tehrani

• Voice Director: Shawn Gann

• Assistant Voice Director: Kevin D. Thelwell

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Derric Benavides

• Assistant Engineer: Katie Saltkill

• Mixer: James Baker

The third season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

yorushika performs the third season's opening theme song "Kumo o Nukekazashimo e Watashidake" (I Am Alone, Breaking Through the Clouds Downwind). Eve performs the anime's ending theme song "AIYOU."

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

The franchise also has the upcoming Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ( The Apothecary Diaries : The Deceased Empress' Treasure) film , which will open in theaters on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . The franchise also has an upcoming live-action series that will debut on Amazon Prime Video worldwide in 2028.

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print. Viz Media is releasing Minoji Kurata 's separate The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace manga adaptation in print.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Finally Debuts Mereoleona’s Fieriest Form After 5 Years
content:
Black Clover Season 2 doesn’t waste time before getting into action as the Magic Knights and mages from the Heart Kingdom attack the Spade Kingdom. The anime returns after five years with more stunning visuals than ever. While the manga has already reached its conclusion this year, the anime still has to adapt the two final arcs. The anime began airing in 2017 as a weekly series, which is why it caught up to the manga by 2021. It took the anime even longer to return when the manga transitioned to JUMP GIGA, a quarterly magazine, in 2022 due to Yuki Tabata’s health issues.

The first season of the anime only adapted the initial phase of the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc, but the real fight will be featured in the latest season. As always, Mereoleona is in the middle of the action. When it comes to Squad Captains, there aren’t many Mages in the Kingdom who can surpass them, but she has always been an exception . She has been a crucial character to the story ever since she stepped in to fill the role temporarily when her brother, Fuegoleon Vermillion, was comatose after the attack from the Midnight Sun. The latest episode of the anime features her most powerful form yet as she surpasses her own limits ahead of a major battle.

Black Clover Gives Mereoleona the Spotlight She Deserves With Her New Form

As someone fighting on the front lines against the Spade Kingdom’s devils , Mereoleona is going all out from the beginning. Despite all her strength, she knew her powers wouldn’t be enough against the devils that are immune to most forms of magic. Along with the Magic Knights, she trained for several months, pushing past the limits of her powers. Her Hellfire Incarnate form, which she used for the first time in the canon story, is the result of her efforts. While this form was briefly featured in the Wizard of the Sword King movie, it’s not considered a canon story.

Throughout the story before the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc, Mereoleona has fought without her Grimoire. She focuses on her raw physical strength, unlike other mages, and that’s what makes her truly exceptional. However, her Hellfire Incarnate uses a massive amount of mana, and she uses her open Grimoire to assimilate her fire magic into her own body. The power is so intense that she is covered in intense flames. Not only that, but it’s thanks to her delicate control over her mana that she is able to maintain such a complicated form.

However, while this form severely boosts her powers, it also has a major drawback if used for too long. Mereoleona will be using this form a couple more times in the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc. It’s only the beginning of the battle, and things will only get more intense from here on out. Although the Magic Knights are more than prepared for the battle, the challenge ahead of them is more terrifying than anything they have faced before. The fight will continue in the upcoming Episode 3 , which will be out on October 17th.

The first season of the anime only adapted the initial phase of the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc, but the real fight will be featured in the latest season. As always, Mereoleona is in the middle of the action. When it comes to Squad Captains, there aren’t many Mages in the Kingdom who can surpass them, but she has always been an exception . She has been a crucial character to the story ever since she stepped in to fill the role temporarily when her brother, Fuegoleon Vermillion, was comatose after the attack from the Midnight Sun. The latest episode of the anime features her most powerful form yet as she surpasses her own limits ahead of a major battle.
Black Clover Gives Mereoleona the Spotlight She Deserves With Her New Form

contentBlocks.credit: Image Courtesy of Pierrot

contentBlocks.text: As someone fighting on the front lines against the Spade Kingdom’s devils , Mereoleona is going all out from the beginning. Despite all her strength, she knew her powers wouldn’t be enough against the devils that are immune to most forms of magic. Along with the Magic Knights, she trained for several months, pushing past the limits of her powers. Her Hellfire Incarnate form, which she used for the first time in the canon story, is the result of her efforts. While this form was briefly featured in the Wizard of the Sword King movie, it’s not considered a canon story.

Throughout the story before the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc, Mereoleona has fought without her Grimoire. She focuses on her raw physical strength, unlike other mages, and that’s what makes her truly exceptional. However, her Hellfire Incarnate uses a massive amount of mana, and she uses her open Grimoire to assimilate her fire magic into her own body. The power is so intense that she is covered in intense flames. Not only that, but it’s thanks to her delicate control over her mana that she is able to maintain such a complicated form.

However, while this form severely boosts her powers, it also has a major drawback if used for too long. Mereoleona will be using this form a couple more times in the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc. It’s only the beginning of the battle, and things will only get more intense from here on out. Although the Magic Knights are more than prepared for the battle, the challenge ahead of them is more terrifying than anything they have faced before. The fight will continue in the upcoming Episode 3 , which will be out on October 17th.

title: GKIDS Offers CITY the Animation on BD Collector's Edition on December 15
content:
GKIDS announced on Thursday that it will release Kyoto Animation 's CITY The Animation , the television anime of Keiichi Arawi 's CITY manga, in a Collector's Edition Blu-ray Disc that will be available exclusively on its online store on December 15.

The release will include a 72-page booklet, four art cards, an A3 poster, cut out movies 1-13, previews, TV spots, team preview, and the clean opening and ending animation sequences without onscreen credits.

The series streamed worldwide on Amazon Prime Video in July 2025.

Taichi Ishidate ( Violet Evergarden , Beyond the Boundary ) directed the anime at Kyoto Animation . The anime was the first non-sequel anime for Kyoto Animation in six years. Tamami Tokuyama (animation director for Sound! Euphonium: Ensemble Contest Arc , key animator for Liz and the Blue Bird ) was the character designer and chief animation director. Shiori Yamazaki (background art for Violet Evergarden: The Movie , Sound! Euphonium The Movie - Our Promise: A Brand New Day ) was the art director. Additionally, Kana Miyata was the color designer, Hiroki Ueda was s the director of photography, Tatsunori Kase was the 3D director, and Yōta Tsuruoka was the sound director. The members of the quartet Piranhans composed the anime's music. Pony Canyon wasin charge of music production.

Singer-songwriter Riho Furui performed the opening theme song "Hello," and singer-songwriter TOMOO performed the ending theme song "Lucky."

Kyoto Animation describes the anime:

This town, is not just a normal town.There's laughter, love and emotional moments.An unpredictable ordinary life presented by the residents!Exciting stuffs come one after another. Welcome to CITY .

Arawi ( Nichijou , Helvetica Standard ) launched the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in September 2016, and ended the series the first time in February 2021. Kodansha published the 13th and then-final compiled book volume in April 2021.

Vertical (now Kodansha USA ) published the entire series in English. The manga is also available on Kodansha 's K MANGA service.

The manga returned in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in December 2024. The manga ended again with its 15th volume in December 2025.

title: Kodansha USA Licenses Jackpot Girls, Powerless Without You, Occult Times, 7 Other Manga
content:
Kodansha USA Publishing announced on Thursday new manga releases for its Kodansha Print Club, as well as new licenses.

The Kodansha Print Club titles include:

Title: Burn the House Down Creator: Moyashi Fujisawa Release: January 2027 Synopsis: Assuming a false identity and working as a housekeeper, “Shizuka Yamauchi” infiltrates the well-to-do Mitarai household in pursuit of the truth. Thirteen years prior, when the Mitarai home was engulfed in flames, Shizuka's mother was forced to take the fall for the crime. Now, on her first assignment with the family, Shizuka homes in on Makiko, the beautiful second wife of Dr. Mitarai. But Mrs. Mitarai harbors sinister secrets of her own…

Title: When Arika Went Missing Creator: Moyashi Fujisawa (story), Kumakazu (art) Release: January 2027 Synopsis: Beloved idol Arika Mamiya has been missing for a year, but her best friend Nana Miyajima hasn't stopped looking for answers. Determined to uncover the truth, Nana sets out to infiltrate Arika's group by becoming a member herself—a daunting mission for a rude, tone-deaf loner who couldn't be further from idol material. But when auditions begin and Nana tanks in the fan rankings, she's forced to ditch her lone-wolf ways and fight for the spotlight, all while discovering the ugly world that lurks beneath the smiles and sparkle of idol life.

Title: Manchuria Opium Squad Creator: Shikako , Tsukasa Monma Release: January 2027 Synopsis: In the corrupt, conflict-ridden Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo, the illegal opium trade is a perilous path to quick riches—or a swift death. Desperate to save his doomed family, the young Isamu Higata seizes a dangerous opportunity, using his botanical expertise to make mind-blowing opium in hopes of cashing in. But when sinister gangs and the oppressive state catch wind of his operation, Isamu is thrust deeper and deeper into a treacherous world of deceit and depravity to protect himself and those he loves.

Title: Kamakura Bakeneko Club: Uncanny Cat Tales Creator: Daisuke Igarashi Release: February 2027 Synopsis: An old rumor persists in the ancient coastal city of Kamakura: find your way to the elusive Bakeneko Club, and you'll be reunited with a lost or departed cat. Remote worker Arisa spends her days at a local café, where visitors drawn by the rumor share stories of their uncanny feline encounters with the two peculiar young men behind the counter. But in this primeval place where the boundary between the human world and the spirit realm wears thin, their tales might awaken the interest of more than just a curious eavesdropper…

Title: Umwelt and Other Stories Creator: Daisuke Igarashi Release: March 2027 Synopsis: Ten unforgettable short stories spanning modern folklore to surreal science fiction from Daisuke Igarashi , the award-winning artist behind Children of the Sea and Witches .

Title: Futarijime Romantic Creator: Chihiro Kanisawa Release: March 2027 Synopsis: Kokomi Kumamori has been waiting ever since a kindergarten first kiss for fate to deliver the storybook romance she was promised. Then Kyohei Tajima—a boy with the very same name as her childhood prince—walks into her life. But he's rude, romance-averse, and definitely the wrong Kyohei…so why does he keep making her heart skip a beat? From sports-festival sparks to beachside butterflies, every new side of him she discovers has Mr. Wrong seeming more and more like Mr. Right.

A hopeless romantic finds something better than the love story she's always imagined—but not without a few fantasies shattered along the way. One high school girl learns that love rarely follows the script in this short and sweet three-volume shojo rom-com.

Title: Ark of the Canaries Creator: Misaki Takamatsu Release: April 2027 Synopsis: Gossip, track meets, squabbles with mom… Upbeat Yuri's not ready for high school to be over, but graduation looms on the horizon. One afternoon on her walk home, a flying mass swallows up the sky, raining destruction upon all she can see. The place Yuri later wakes up in is quiet; the lone being there with her is a man in a lab coat. As social ritual and organic matter unravel around the girl, desolation threatens her singular goal: returning home.

The new licenses include:

Title: Hitorijime Boyfriend : Re Creator: Memeco Arii Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: More than a decade after the BL one-shot Hitorijime Boyfriend , original creator Memeco Arii returns to the couple that started it all: After many tribulations, Kensuke and Hasekura have graduated from high school and moved in together! But Kensuke's just as popular at his part-time job as he was in school, and Hasekura can feel his jealousy bubbling back up… Then, one morning, he notices Kensuke's covered bite marks?! Don't miss this single-volume sequel sixteen years in the making!

Title: I Remember the Color of the Wind Creator: Kazari Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: When Mori hears his classmates trying to nervously build up the courage to talk to Michioto, one of the most popular boys in school, he has no problem offering to get his enigmatic classmate's phone number. But when Mori's eyes meet Michioto's, it's more than Michioto's good looks that takes Mori's breath away, and Mori falls in love at first sight. Soon, Mori is overwhelmed by feelings of first love. Luckily for him, circumstance and after circumstance starts to bring him and Michioto closer together, and the two become fast friends. But will Mori's newfound friendship alone be enough to satisfy him, or will he risk it all for the chance of something more?

Title: Powerless Without You ( Muryoku Seijo to Munō Ōjo ) Creator: Tama Tamasaki Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: In this thrilling yuri fantasy, Nana's just out of college, trying to make her way on a series of part-time jobs, when she finds herself whisked away from her bedroom into a parallel world of magic! To her shock, she's told that she is the great Saintess who will bring peace and prosperity to the whole country. Except for one tiny problem—she soon discovers she has absolutely zero magical power—none! To make matters worse, the princess she's been summoned to serve with can't cast even a single spell. A Saintess with no magic power, and a princess who can't use her own—a pair of failures, doomed to become a laughingstock…or a partnership that might deepen into something more?

Title: Tell Me, Dear Butler Creator: Michi Masaki Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: The hot-headed and judgmental Kikyo is used to having servants appease her every need. As a child, she scared away almost all of her attendants. But when the new young butler, Hanayagi is introduced, he engages with her in a rather unique way. Treating each other as equals. They are both kids, after all. Now in high school, Kikyo hasn't given up this unrequited love for her butler, despite it being indecorum for her social status. No matter how many times she tries to get his attention, it doesn't seem to have any effect on him…or does it? This romantic comedy was the inaugural winner of the Honto Aotagai Comic Award, an award for up-and-coming manga.

Title: My Rebound Has Too Much Game! Creator: Asumi Takabuchi Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: When Kohane gets unceremoniously ghosted and dumped by her boyfriend, she's determined to move on and immediately sets her eyes on Mizuma, a bespectacled shy boy at school who's a dreamboat of a neighbor without his glasses at home. Mizuma is a reluctant rebound at first, but Kohane takes the fake it till you make it approach, conspicuously posing them as the perfect lovey-dovey couple in public. The sham relationship started out as a petty game of revenge, but could the rebound turn into true love?

Title: Zacha's Undying Love Creator: Nori Arashiyama Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: Searching for his lost love, handsome vampire Zacha turns up at the home of the elderly Tsugumi and her granddaughters Yumeko and Himari. Thrilled by the arrival of a real-life vampire in her humdrum town, Yumeko is eager to help Zacha, but as they piece together the extraordinary life story of the woman he loved, Yumeko begins unearthing her own family secrets.

Title: Prisoners of Twilight Town Creator: Nagoya Shoki, Morohoshi Fuji Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: Yuma Sendo says goodbye to his picture-perfect life when a wrongful conviction sends him to Twilight Town, a lawless region where Japan's most heinous criminals serve out sentences of capital punishment. Here, even basic necessities must be purchased via pounds of flesh, earned by offering up the corpses of fellow inmates. What hope does the very ordinary Yuma have to survive this dog-eat-dog world? The answer may lie in him accepting that he may not be so ordinary after all…

Title: Snow Globe Town Creator: Rie Kano Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: High school students Ako and Tako share a dream of leaving their hometown of Takaoka to pursue the literary life in Tokyo—but they face more than the ordinary obstacles of small-town dreamers. For the past 10 years, Takaoka has been cut off from the rest of the world by a mysterious, ceaseless snowfall, fostering a superstition among its residents that venturing beyond means risking death. When a famous novelist suddenly arrives in town, his presence shakes up Ako and Tako's lives, and a flurry of strange and sinister events begin to swirl around them.

Title: Jackpot Girls ( Dream Jumbo Girl ) Creator: Hiroyuki Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: To secure her future financial and career success, studious high school student Chie aims to get accepted into the prestigious Tokyo University. Meanwhile her best friend, the air-headed goofball Kanae, just wants to enjoy her life in the moment. One day, Kanae buys a lottery ticket and ends up winning first prize! And how much money is that you may ask? A staggering 700 million yen! When the girls decide to split the winnings, Chie suddenly finds that the burden of being responsible for such a fortune is too much and she ends up flunking her entrance exams! With her planned-out future crumbling around her, Chie decides, "Screw it!". If her life isn't going to go the way she'd planned, then she's going to use her newfound fortune to live the best life she ever could!

Title: Occult Times Creator: Idonchi Release: Fall 2027 Synopsis: Rei's dream is to become a photojournalist, so when she enrolls at Hazama Academy, she naturally joins the school newspaper…which she's shocked to find has only one other staff member: another girl named Shiro, who is obsessed with the occult! She's about to walk out the door, when Shiro accidentally discovers Rei's weakness for all things cute. In exchange for a plushie of a mythical flying cat, Rei joins Shiro on a nighttime stakeout, hoping to catch a ghost in the school bathroom. In the darkness, Rei can hardly believe her eyes when Shiro, in her excitement, starts to transform…into an adorable catgirl?! Can this school really be haunted with all kinds of monsters… cute ones?

title: Shonen Jump’s Newest and Hottest Leading Manga Is Fixing One of Shonen’s Biggest Flaws
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump has produced some of the most prominent manga series for decades. However, even among its waves of amazing shonen manga, one element has consistently been lacking, and this new manga series is fixing it perfectly. The term shonen itself refers to young boys, which is why the genre has often been criticized for its lack of well-written female characters. While many series do include female characters, they are often relegated to slapstick comedy and stereotypical roles, frequently portrayed as fawning over male characters characterized as studs. Even great series like Naruto have been criticized for their poor female character writing.

However, as times have changed, so has shonen manga, including its approach to female characters. The Naruto sequel itself is a recent example , as Sarada Uchiha has proven her worth, while her dynamic with Sumire, involving a romantic element, demonstrates that female characters can shine even in stories with romantic plots. However, what Ichi the Witch , one of the hottest and newest leading shonen series, has accomplished is arguably something few shonen series have done before. By placing female characters at the forefront and featuring only a few male characters, Ichi the Witch has subverted a common shonen trope and delivered the character development that female characters in the genre have always deserved.

Shonen Jump’s Hottest New Series Has the Perfect Cheat Code for Fixing Female Characters in Shonen

Ichi the Witch is set in a world where only biological females can wield magic and become witches. This premise already establishes that the series will feature many female characters at the forefront, despite having a male lead who becomes a witch under special circumstances. The series never forgets its foundation, constantly reminding readers that its female characters are its soul. This is best demonstrated in the latest chapter, Ichi the Witch Chapter 101, titled “To the Beyond.” It features Kumugi Harvest, a prominent member of Ichi’s team, as she finally unveils her true power. Kumugi was always portrayed as a nerd with limited magical prowess and seemingly weak characteristics.

However, the latest chapter confirms that she always had the potential to become stronger, more so than many female characters depicted in the genre. Kumugi had simply forgotten her abilities because of the trauma caused by her overwhelming power.
